sloka: यदहं गात्रसंस्पर्शं रावणस्य बलाद्गता ।अनीशा किं करिष्यामि विनाथा विवशा सती ।। ५.३७.६१।।।।
transliteration: yadahaṁ gātrasaṁsparśaṁ rāvaṇasya balādgatā ।anīśā kiṁ kariṣyāmi vināthā vivaśā satī ।। 5.37.61।।।।

translations.english: "O chief of vanaras I cherish my devotion towards Rama alone and not touch the body of any other man.
